name: agentloop-multi-runtime
description: Reference multi-runtime control plane and AgentLoop runtime host

scripts.package:local-agent:mac: npm run build --workspace @zhujun/agentloop && npm run build --workspace @zhujun/agentloop-skills && node scripts/package-local-agent-macos.mjs
scripts.package:local-agent:win: node scripts/assert-windows-local-agent-build.mjs && npm run build --workspace @zhujun/agentloop && npm run build --workspace @zhujun/agentloop-skills && node scripts/package-local-agent-windows.mjs
scripts.test:contracts: node --test --test-isolation=process --test-name-pattern='^(shared state configuration switches between SQLite, PostgreSQL, and role-specific TiDB without changing Host code|Docker Compose passes independent TiDB settings to Router and Runtime Hosts|Router state never initializes Runtime kernel tables, while Runtime state does|role migrations record an immutable checksum and fail closed on history drift|PostgreSQL migration ledger stores millisecond timestamps without integer overflow|Runtime Host validates deployment-required commands before accepting Runs|persistent Router depends on control-plane and artifact ports, not their adapters|shared Router-Host contracts preserve artifact identity without importing Runtime kernel types|Multi Runtime TiDB DDL is owned by Router and Host persistence, not the AgentLoop kernel|local launcher gives Router and Runtime Hosts the same shared workspace mount)$' tests/multi-runtime.test.ts
